info.title: Mane Man API: the technician app
info.description: mm-api on the technician app's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*. Every route but /api/health and /api/tech/auth/* needs the mm_tech session cookie, which is bound to one phone, and every write needs the page's own Origin. Every write also takes an X-Client-Event-Id and is idempotent on it, so a phone replaying its outbox lands each write once (docs/decisions/0038-offline-writes.md). No response here carries an amount. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

sector.description: The area, never the street: the one the visit's pincode is in, from the service area; else the address's locality, or the city.

badge.description: Free for a visit the price book charges nothing for; at_visit for a one visit, paid for once the client is fitted. No response to a technician carries an amount.

slots.description: How much of the day the visit takes: 1, 1.5 or 2 slots. Null for an unknown type.

technician.description: The first name of who did it.

photo_url.description: Its after photograph, never to be kept on the phone.

last_visit.description: The client's latest earlier visit with after photographs; null for a first visit.

reminder.description: The day-before or arrival WhatsApp to the client, and when it was delivered.

steps.description: The steps this visit type runs, in order; a consultation's and a one visit's take the profile.

checklist.description: This kind of visit's checklist, as ops set it in the console, in its order.

partial_reasons.description: The reasons a job may be left partly done, as ops set them, in their order.

consumables.description: Every consumable the technician may record, those this job's service is expected to use first, each with the count its stepper starts at.

products.description: On a one visit and a consultation, the products by name and never by price: the first fit's services offered on the visit's day, in ops' order, which a one visit's client chooses from and the profile names. Empty for any other visit.

url.description: The link Razorpay texted the client, to show them; null until Razorpay has made it.

payment_link.description: On a one visit closed as done with the client fitted, its payment link; else null.

given_by.description: client: as they booked; ops: on the booking in the console; technician: at the visit.

discount_code.description: On a one visit, the discount code already on it, so the outcome step asks for none; never what it takes off. Null on any other visit, and on a one visit with no code.

profile.description: The client's hair profile as it stands, for the piece card and for the profile step to start from. Null until the day before the visit, or before one is recorded.

wait_ends_at.description: When the job may close as a no-show, from the check-in we hold; null before one landed.

distance_m.description: How far from the address that check-in was; null when nothing could be measured.

steps_done.description: The steps that have reached us, in that order: the job's events, and the profile once recorded.

code.description: What the consumables step sends back.

unit.description: What one is counted in: strip, ml, sachet.

expected.description: How many this job's service is expected to use; 0 for one it lists no use for.

tier.description: What the piece step sends back as product.

id.description: The version's own ID, which a write names as based_on.

distance_m.description: Null when the address has no coordinates, so nothing could be measured.

replayed.description: True when this write had already landed.

upload_url.description: A path on this host. PUT the photograph there.

small_upload_url.description: A path on this host. PUT the photograph's small copy there, once the photograph is in.

take.description: This upload of the angle's photograph, which its small copy's upload names.

anyOf.description: A consumable by the name the technician gave it, as a phone queued it before codes.

ConsumablesRequest.description: What was used, each by the code the job's card gave it. None used is an empty list. A code the catalogue does not hold is refused, fields items.

old_piece.description: On a replacement: the piece that came off, and why it failed.

product.description: On a one visit, and only there: the product the client chose, by its tier from the card's products.

PieceFitted.description: The piece fitted, with its base and lot, and on a replacement the one that came off. A failure_reason on the piece itself marks it as failed and fits nothing.

PieceDeclined.description: On a one visit, and only there: the client decided against the fit, so nothing was fitted, and closing the visit as done makes it a consultation.

replayed.description: True when this write had already landed.

TechnicianProfileRecorded.description: Kept in our records alone: nothing of it goes to FSM.

based_on.description: The id of the version the form started from: the latest as it was read; null where there was none.

TechnicianProfileRequest.description: The client's whole profile as it stands now: the card's latest, changed where the technician changed it. Each is a new version.

reason.description: One of the card's partial_reasons, by its id; one ops have since taken off is still taken.

PieceLookup.description: Whether the label is one of the job's client's pieces.

code.description: The code, as it is kept: in capitals.
